findings.issue: Round-2 MINOR is mostly fixed. Computed globalThis access, direct and indirect eval, globalThis.eval, new Function, Function(), string setTimeout, globalThis aliasing and Reflect.get(globalThis, ...) are all rejected now. One way round remains: you can still get the Function constructor through any function's .constructor property, and calling it is not flagged by no-new-func. Bare Function as a value, e.g. Reflect.apply(Function, ...), is not flagged either. Bot or advice code could use this to evaluate 'return indexedDB' and reach stored hands. This was already missing before this change, and it takes deliberate evasion. It is not drift that a reviewer would miss, so it stays defence in depth.
findings.evidence: Linted in-process with the repo config, in both src/bots/zz.ts and src/advice/zz.ts: `(function f() { return 1; }).constructor('return indexedDB')()`, `f.constructor('return indexedDB')()` with f an arrow, `[].constructor.constructor('return indexedDB')()` and `Reflect.apply(Function, null, ['return 1'])` -> 0 errors. No src/bots or src/advice file uses .constructor today.
findings.fix: Optional. Add { selector: "MemberExpression[property.name='constructor']" } to BOT_DETERMINISM_RESTRICTED_SYNTAX, and put 'Function' in BARE_GLOBAL_REFERENCE's name list (or no-restricted-globals for BOT_DETERMINISM_FILES).

findings.issue: In bots, `export {} from '../table/session'` is not flagged. In advice, the side-effect-only `import '../engine/hand'` is not flagged. Neither binds a value, so no state is reachable through them. In bots, `import('../advice/Golden')` in type position and, in advice, `import('./Golden')` in type position are not flagged either. These are types only and get no runtime value. None of these is a reachable path.
findings.evidence: Probe results: 0 restricted-rule errors for each of the four snippets.

summary: Round-2 MAJOR is fixed. The MetaProperty ban on import.meta rejects import.meta.glob, globEager, .url, .env and destructuring of import.meta in src/bots, src/bots/styles, src/advice, src/advice/ranges, src/engine, src/stats and src/table. No headless module uses import.meta, so the ban breaks nothing. Round-2 MINOR is mostly fixed, see above. All earlier round-1 and round-2 probe cases still behave as expected (about 160 cases re-run). The only mismatches are non-reachable: side-effect-only and empty re-exports, and type-only case variants. The fix-3 gates pass. No new dependencies, secrets or randomness changes. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings remain.
